title: Priority Chef Heavy Duty Mortar and Pestle Set, 1.5 Cup, 100% Granite, Non Slip Base, Make Fresh Guacamole, Salsa, Pesto, Stone Grinder Bowl, Herb Crusher, Spice Grinder, 5.5 Inch - Black
description:
About this item
BUILT TO LAST, This thick, chunky solid stone grinder is individually carved by hand from 1 solid piece of naturally formed granite. Your heavy duty guacamole bowl grinder will look great on any countertop and will do for many years to come.
MAKE DELICIOUS GUACAMOLE, SALSA, PESTO and MORE! Home made, fresh delicious guacamole, pesto and more can be made on demand within minutes in the comfort of your home. Create healthy sauces with ease using your granite molcajete that the whole family can enjoy.
GRIND, BLEND and MASH THE FRESHEST FLAVORS: This mortar and pestle set with a generous 1.5 cup capacity and sturdy 6-inch pestle gets the job dine quickly. Crush, grind and pound herbs, nuts, spices and more to release natural flavors and aromas easily with minimum fuss.
DON'T SCRATCH YOUR COUNTERTOP: This black granite stone mortar and pestle is a beast! Super sturdy and heavy enough to leave out on display, but that could cause scratches to your countertop. That's why we have INCLUDED 2 NON SLIP COUNTERTOP PROTECTORS that will protect your valuable counter from any possible scratches.
PREP YOUR GARLIC - FAST: Our customers love using their Priority Chef mortar and pestle to crush garlic. So, we INCLUDED A BPA FREE SILICONE GARLIC PEELER that removes those sticky, papery skins quickly without getting garlic fingers.
reviews_5s: This item has been a game changer for me in the kitchen, especially with guacamole and pico de gallo making. It was easy to prep and reliable to use for more than a year. It is heavy: I believe it will last a lifetime, but also it can be awkward if you want to tilt it with one hand to transfer contents to a bowl. To me, this is worth it because it’s large enough to hold a batch of guacamole made with three large avocados. It’s so beautiful that I leave it out on the kitchen counter.It's exceptionally good. reviews_1s:
My fault, I didn’t make enough effort to determine everything about the mortar and pestle. There are no instructions available on the Amazon web site, you have to wait until the product arrives. The carton includes a small instruction leaflet. I included a photo of that leaflet with this review.

I didn’t expect instructions to be required, I thought, “It’s a granite mortar and pestle. Grind stuff in it, wash it with soap and water, it’ll be great!” Nope.

There is a regimen required to break it in and maintain it. I don’t even have the stuff it says I need to use to season it. Season granite?!?! And it says that if you don’t do this, you might get granite In your food. I’m not using anything that might contaminate my food with rock!

You can’t use dish soap or other cleaners. You can’t wash it in a dish washer. While I don’t use a dish washer, I think that most people do, and it should be disclosed in an obvious way that this isn’t dish washer safe.

I suppose there are people who will read this review and say, “You should have known all this.” How? It’s not disclosed anywhere, I have no experience using mortar and pestles, or using granite. I know granite is a rock that is used on expensive counter tops, and that’s about it.

It’s going into the garbage, and I’ll look for something else, maybe plastic. It’ll just add to all of the plastic I already ingest from chemicals in our environment.Garbage. Flakes off into food. Avoid. Get something that's been smoothed and won't flake stones into your food.Two in a row broken. Previouly openedMudler came broken an a half .🥺They call it "Heavy duty", yet it can't even survive gentle shipping. The first thing I said to my son on receiving the Pestle and Mortar was, "Check the Pestle please, lot of reviews mention broken Pestles." Sure enough the Pestle was broken. If this breakage was due to rough shipping I'd accept it and request a replacement, however it is not! There were no signs of damage on either the shipping box or the items display packaging box. The pestle, a long solid rod of granite, came inside a cheap, thin plastic bubble wrap envelope I wouldn't even trust to protect a postcard. Since the manufacturers can't be bothered to design or use adequate protective packaging I have no reason to think they take any pride in the quality of the items within. I returned it immediately.Product arrived broken, exchanged and the 2nd one was also brokenThis arrived with an expanding hairline crack and a crack in the center of the bowl.I'm disappointed. The pestle was broken in two. The packaging on the outer box and the box the mortar and pestle were in were fine. It looks like it was broken when it was originally packaged. I didn't even look at the mortar. I also noticed that the pestle was rough the entire length. I ordered gray. It was misleading because the photos for the black one show a smooth area where your hand would be. It wasn't such a "Prime" deal after all. I'm so glad I looked at it. Otherwise it would have been an awful gift. I'm returning it for a refund.Nothing like described or pictured! Some kind of melted plastic bowl & a small stone for a pestle. Buyers beware!!!No,
